sources.title: LFM3-1.7B - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: ← Back to Text Models LFM3-1.7B is Liquid AI's text model for local agents and specialized applications, based on the new LFM3 tri-hybrid architecture. It is post-trained for agentic harnesses such as Hermes Agent, Pi, and OpenClaw, with a 256K-token context window. At 4-bit precision, it takes about 1 GB of memory, so it fits on any phone or laptop.

sources.title: Liquid AI Releases LFM3: 6 Open-Weight 2B-Class Multimodal Models
sources.snippet: Liquid AI LFM3 is a family of 6 open-weight, 2B-class models built on one shared backbone. The family covers text, vision, audio, omni and decision tasks. Every model can be fine-tuned on a single GPU. Developers can then deploy on phones, laptops, private servers or the cloud. TL;DR Size: LFM3-1.7B has 1.73B parameters and a 256K context window.

sources.title: Liquid AI Launches LFM3: 1.7B Multimodal Models with 256K Context
sources.snippet: Liquid AI has released the LFM3 family of six open-weight 2B multimodal models built on a shared LFM3-1.7B-Base architecture, featuring a 256K context window and 35% parameter savings. The text model outperforms LFM2.5-2.6B by a wide margin (38.42 vs. 3.02 on WebArena-Verified) and runs on a single device with 1GB memory at 4-bit precision. sources.title: Introducing LFM3: Every Modality for Specialized Intelligence
sources.snippet: More capability per parameter: a new tri-hybrid architecture and training recipe allow LFM3-1.7B to outperform our previous LFM2.5-2.6B while using 35% fewer parameters. Every modality, one backbone: six 2B-class models (text, vision, audio, omni, and decision) trained from LFM3-1.7B-Base. Built for the edge: the text model fits in about 1 GB at 4-bit precision.
